name: Senpi
summary: Turns a described trading strategy into a Hyperliquid agent, with a free trial and official Pro, Advanced and Quant plans at 45 €, 89 € and 178 € a month.
description: Senpi (Senpi AI Inc., Austin, Texas) is an AI trading-agent product: it turns a described strategy into software that can run on Hyperliquid. Paid plans have 0% Senpi trading fees and access to all models. You can connect Claude, ChatGPT and more on the paid plans.

pricing.details: Free trial (9 € of AI credits once, 0.03% Senpi trading fee). Pro 45 €/month (49 € credits, 0% Senpi fees); Advanced 89 €/month (103 € credits); Quant 178 €/month (214 € credits).
pricing.label: Freemium

features: Turns a described strategy into a Hyperliquid trading agent
0% Senpi trading fees on paid plans
Official HQ in Austin, United States
